messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — our next biweekly release currently lands on Mon Apr 5. UK/IE have a bank holiday that day and several owners (sam + nina) flagged OOO. Thinking we should either move the train 2 days earlier or postpone one week. Thoughts? :calendar:

aj: Do we have hard cutoffs tied to CI windows or cloud maintenance? moving 48h earlier could bump some long-running feature PRs.

sam: I'm OOO on Apr 5 afternoon but can help in the morning. My big PR (#1245) still needs final review, but it's already green. Link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1245|PR #1245>

nina: I can be offline all day Apr 5. +1 to moving earlier if we can keep cutoff at EOD Thu Apr 2.

maria: Constraints: release engineering needs 24h to run canaries + smoke tests after merges. CI quota window for dedicated infra is booked for Apr 4 in the evening (maintenance). deploy-bot, any conflicts?

deploy-bot: Automated note: infra maintenance booked 2026-04-04 20:00-23:00 UTC (affects canary clusters). This will block late-night canaries on Apr 4.

aj: Given that, moving earlier to Thu Apr 1 or Fri Apr 2 might be tight for some teams. Alternative: do a smaller patch train on Apr 5 (only critical fixes) and postpone non-blocking features to the next train on Apr 19.

sam: If we do patch-only on Apr 5, can we rely on release-coordinator to pick commits and do emergency version bumps? I can prepare a version bump PR for the patch train before I go.

release-coordinator: I can handle cherry-picks and the patch train. For clarity: propose option A) Shift main train to Fri Apr 2 (cutoff Thu EOD), or B) Keep Apr 5 but run patch-only (cherry-picks) with full train on Apr 19. Vote with reactions.

maria: Quick poll — react with :one: for A (shift), :two: for B (patch-only). I'll tally in 2 hours. Also, if we shift, we need everyone with open feature PRs to either rebase or mark for the Apr 19 train.

aj: :one: — prefer shift if it doesn't force any teams to break merges.

sam: :two: — patch-only works for me since I'm partially OOO.

nina: :one: — prefer earlier so QA isn't stretched across holiday.

maria: Tally so far: A(shift)=2, B(patch-only)=1. Action items if A wins:
- owners with open feature PRs: mark WIP or move to milestone v1.15.0-next
- release-coordinator: bump version to v1.15.0 and open release PR by Wed EOD
- eng-releases: set cutoff Thu Apr 1 23:59 UTC

maria: I'll wait the 2 hours, then post final decision and update calendar event. If A selected, here's the quick bump command I plan to run (feel free to test locally):
```bash
git checkout release/v1.15
./scripts/bump-version.sh 1.15.0
git push origin release/v1.15
# open PR: GH link will be posted here
```

release-coordinator: Noted. If A wins I'll create the release PR and tag QA. Also will send a changelog nudge to #docs and #product to review highlights for the release notes.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll update here with final pick and update the biweekly calendar if we shift. :thumbsup:
